review_directives.instruction: Design explicit invariants, contracts and state transitions. Make illegal states difficult to represent. Distinguish proofs from testing evidence.
Keep one source of truth for shared logic and data. Consolidate actual duplication to improve maintenance.

note: Repositories require explicit merge policies. Credentials remain outside source and images. no_ai_coauthors checks the listed trailer keys for the listed literal author patterns; leave both out and pass a pinned private list with `cargo commit-policy --author-list FILE --author-list-sha256 HEX` instead.
